nodes.prompt:
Repo: llm-ai-search-seo (AEO Shopify app; Firebase Functions packages/functions/src). Read the repo CLAUDE.md. Base: main (MR !153 shopInfos allow-list already merged).
HIGH (pre-existing, same MR because same endpoint): PUT/POST /api/shop non-domain branch → updateShopData (repositories/shopRepository.js:~108-111) strips only blockFields (plan, isDevZone, installedAt, aeoLimits, aeoUsage, limitsEnabled, limitsAppliedAt, isEnableLimitedUrls) for untrusted callers. shopifyDomain, accessToken, accessTokenHash, crispSessionToken, passwordStore, email stay merchant-writable. Writing another shop's shopifyDomain makes storefront lookups getShopByField(shopDomain).limit(1) (additionalTxtFileController.js:~286, aiReferralController.js:~79, webhookLogRepository.js:~10) resolve to the attacker's doc. Fix: add shopifyDomain, accessToken, accessTokenHash, crispSessionToken, email, and any other credential/identity field you find on the shop doc to the untrusted strip (keep trusted writers working). Grep packages/assets/src: confirm no merchant screen sends them (passwordStore IS sent by DevZone — check whether DevZone is trusted; if merchants legitimately set passwordStore from a non-DevZone screen keep it writable). Also gate the `domain` (shopInfos) branch on isTrustedWriter(ctx) only if the only FE sender is DevZone (DevZone.js:~262).
Tests: untrusted PUT {shopifyDomain:'b.myshopify.com', accessToken:'x'} persists neither; trusted path still can.
Rules: TDD — failing test first. Comments say WHY only, never narrate WHAT. Use the repo logger, never add console.*. No secrets, no new deps; do not touch .env*, lockfiles, .gitlab-ci.yml, AGENTS.md, .npmrc, .yarnrc.yml. HARD RULE packages/functions: never `await import(...)` a local module; lazy-load with require(). DO NOT modify, rewrite or delete any test or file unrelated to the items below, even if it fails — pre-existing failures are listed and excluded. Your sandbox cannot open sockets: never rewrite a test to avoid sockets; if a test you must run needs a socket, say so in the final message. Update docs/features/*.md (and the matching .claude/skills doc if it cites changed lines) for behaviour you change. Run every verify command yourself; format with `DISABLE_V8_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npx eslint --fix <changed files>`. Final message: file:line per change + anything not done and why.

contract.goal: merchant cannot write identity/credential shop fields

verify.name: dir-tests
cmd: F=$( { git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM origin/main -- "*.js" "*.jsx"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- "*.js" "*.jsx"; } | sort -u); [ -z "$F" ] && exit 0; D=$(for f in $F; do d=$(dirname "$f"); echo "${d%/__tests__}"; done | sort -u); npx jest --ci --passWithNoTests $D --testPathIgnorePatterns="/lib/"

verify.name: eslint
cmd: F=$( { git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM origin/main -- "*.js" "*.jsx"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- "*.js" "*.jsx"; } | sort -u); [ -z "$F" ] || DISABLE_V8_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npx eslint  $F
